name: Universal Base Suite (Base64, Base58, Base32, Hex)
desc: Convert data between UTF-8, Base64, Base64URL, Base58, Base32, Hex and Binary in your browser, in any direction. Lossless and UTF-8 aware. Nothing is uploaded.

name: Base58 & Base62 Codec
desc: Encode and decode raw strings, hexadecimal buffers, Bitcoin addresses, IPFS CIDs, and compact database IDs into Base58 and Base62 alphanumeric formats locally in browser RAM. Zero network egress.

name: Universal Data & Stream Decompressor
desc: Decompress Gzip, Deflate, Deflate-Raw, Zlib, and unpack Base64 or Hex archives directly in your browser memory. Zero tracking, zero network egress.

name: Hex Dumper & Binary File Inspector
desc: Inspect binary files, firmware blobs, and raw strings in canonical hexadecimal and ASCII format with instant magic byte detection, Shannon entropy scoring, and SHA-256 hashing. 100% client-side with zero network egress.

name: Apple Property List (plist) Viewer & Decoder
desc: Inspect, decode, and transform macOS and iOS binary property lists (bplist00), XML plists, and mobileconfig files directly in your browser. 100% offline, zero network egress.

name: Protobuf Raw Decoder
desc: Inspect, reverse-engineer, and decode serialized Protocol Buffers (Protobuf) binaries, Hex streams, and Base64 payloads offline in browser memory without .proto schema files. Zero network egress.

name: ROT13 Encoder & Decoder
desc: Encode, decode, and transform text using ROT13, ROT47, ROT5, and ROT18 entirely in volatile browser memory. 100% client-side, zero network egress, zero logs.

name: URL Encoder & Decoder
desc: Encode, decode, parse, and analyze URLs, query strings, and URI components securely in your browser. Zero tracking, zero network egress.
